Actually OIML R 49-1/2006 exists: "Water meters intended for the metering of cold potable water — Part 1: Metrological and technical requirements". So R49-1 is a distinct sub-part. The register's "R049" without the -1 part... Hmm.
  - /2006 = edition year
  - -NL1 = issuing authority
  - -11.01 = year 11 (2011), number 01

So the two forms denote the same certificate: R49-1/2006-NL1-11.01 = R049/2006-NL1-2011.01, with differences:
1. "R49-1" vs "R049": register dropped the "-1" part suffix and padded with zero. The file path also says "certificates/R49/2006/r049-2006-nl1-2011-01.pdf" — register canonical.
